description: Is the CFM bond head data-starved? The head trained ALONE on nested prefixes of one tmQM reservoir sample (256 / 1024 / 4096), scored on one fixed held-out split that is IDENTICAL across arms. Isolates head data volume from every other variable including the velocity field.
scope: CFM DMPNNBondHead alone, tmQM six target metals, no CFM training

measured.val_cohort_identity: n_truth_bonds=8634 matches cfm_bond_accuracy.json exactly, so this is the SAME 192-cloud val set that probe scored

no_bond_fraction_of_candidate_pairs.note: measured twice on six-metal cohorts; a third and fourth run give the same ~0.70

answer: NO — the head is not data-starved
finding: 16x more labelled complexes (256 -> 4096) at matched compute (~5500 grad steps, 800k candidate pairs per arm) produces NO measurable change in either axis that matters. Bond-type macro-F1 tail means 0.7247 / 0.6981 / 0.6864 and exact-match 0.0273 / 0.0234 / 0.0104, with the arms' per-epoch RANGES OVERLAPPING (1024 spans 0.619-0.754, containing 256's 0.702-0.748). Existence F1 is flat at ~0.990 across all three arms and saturates within 2 epochs. Correct reading is FLAT, not DECREASING: the spread is inside single-epoch noise.

precondition_refutations.BLOCKER_1_no_negatives_FALSE: todo.json recorded class0 NO_BOND = 0 occurrences. That count was taken over the truth .BO blocks, which by construction store only bonded pairs. The head is scored over CANDIDATE pairs and every unlisted one defaults to BOND_NO_BOND. Measured four independent times: 69.7-69.9% of candidate pairs are NO_BOND, on cohorts of 16 / 256 / 1024 complexes. NO_BOND is the LARGEST class.
precondition_refutations.BLOCKER_2_imbalance_FALSE: already handled. The trainer computes sqrt-softened inverse-frequency weights renormalised on sum_c p_c w_c = 1; the exponent was swept MEASURED (power 0.5 beats 0.0 and 1.0 on both F1 and PR-AUC) and 0.5 is the default.
precondition_refutations.proposed_mechanism_UNNECESSARY: BLK-G1 proposed pretraining a separate encoder and transferring it. The labels are ALREADY on the training path — the same _bond_target_for_clean_cloud reads them every step. Only volume was missing.

unexplained_gap.what: Head-only training reaches bond F1 0.9912 / PR-AUC 0.9996 where cfm_bond_accuracy.json records a 4-epoch CFM probe at F1 0.481 / PR-AUC 0.593 — on the IDENTICAL val cohort (8634 truth bonds). Same metric function, same target function, same class-weight rule.
unexplained_gap.verified_not_the_stale_bug: It is NOT the pre-fix invented-Pt-donor target: metrics/by_metric/cfm_bond_accuracy.json was committed in the SAME commit (f7fec1f360, 2026-10-04 15:38) as the fix that read the truth instead. So 0.481 was measured with correct targets.
unexplained_gap.candidate_unverified: CFM epochs are not head updates. The recorded probe used batch_size 16 over a 946-cloud cohort = ~59 steps/epoch, so 4 epochs = ~236 head steps, against 1024 head steps at my epoch 4. That 4.3x gap is PLAUSIBLE but NOT MEASURED — no controlled run isolates it.
unexplained_gap.why_it_matters: If joint training suppresses the head, that is a different and larger problem than data volume, and it is adjacent to BLK-C12 (8 of 12 loss terms dead) and to the generation-collapse story. This is a LEAD, not a conclusion.

honest_framing.measured: All numbers MEASURED on this host, 2026-10-10, GPU 0, single seed 0. Targets and scores come from the production _bond_target_for_clean_cloud and evaluate_bond_accuracy, imported unchanged — no metric was reimplemented for this probe.
scope_caveats: Bond-TYPE macro-F1 swings 0.53-0.75 between consecutive epochs WITHIN one arm, which is why the arm comparison is reported as ranges and tail means rather than final-epoch values.
honest_framing.not_established: Nothing about the CFM generation task. This probe never trains the velocity field and never decodes. Whether a better head changes gen_validity or decode_ratio is UNTESTED.
